summary: Royale Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 1, 2026, announcing via press release that it is current on SEC filings, trading has resumed on OTC Pink, and it initiated an OTCQB application. The board continues its previously announced strategic review, with Roth Capital Partners as financial advisor. The filing provides no deal terms. The strategic review, involving exploration of strategic alternatives, may lead to a future transaction. Watch for updates on OTCQB approval or strategic review outcomes, which could affect shareholder value or trading liquidity.
